policy.accuracy_rule: official-only: do not infer unsupported values from family names; local aliases must carry alias_status and evidence.
policy.unknown_rule: unknown means no exact official source found yet; installer must not present it as supported.
policy.secret_policy: no API keys, tokens, or route URLs with secrets are stored.
policy.claude_capacity_override: Claude-family rows are calibration reference only; current Mobius/Pilot/Ant rosters must not select Claude unless human explicitly revises policy.
policy.provider_catalog_rule: Provider catalogs such as OpenRouter fill provider_catalog_references plus provider_* fields (route id, provider context, max output, pricing, supported parameters, architecture). They do not silently overwrite official_* fields unless the row itself is explicitly a provider route.
policy.pricing_unit_rule: OpenRouter /api/v1/models pricing values are USD per token/request/unit. Only prompt, completion, internal_reasoning, input_cache_read, and input_cache_write are normalized into pricing_usd_per_million_tokens. request/image/web_search/audio and future unit-specific keys stay raw with pricing_units_by_key.

capability_field_contract.official_context_window_tokens: Official context window / input token limit when the docs expose it. Use null if not exact in JSON; render as unknown in Markdown.
capability_field_contract.official_max_output_tokens: Official max output token limit when exposed. Do not infer from context.
capability_field_contract.supports_vision: Direct model vision/image support only. Plan-level MCP/tool vision must be documented separately, not counted as direct model vision.
capability_field_contract.supports_thinking: High-level boolean for installer gating only.

thinking_control.control_type: Exact request knob from official docs, e.g. thinkingLevel, thinkingBudget, thinking.type, reasoning.effort.
thinking_control.allowed_values: Official values/range. Use null if docs only state support but not the knob.
thinking_control.default: Official default behavior, including dynamic/forced thinking where documented.
thinking_control.requested_value: Local alias selector value when the MMS alias encodes one; otherwise null.
thinking_control.numeric_budget_tokens: Exact numeric budget only when the API uses a numeric budget for this model.
thinking_control.budget_range_tokens: Range object/list only when official docs expose a numeric range.
thinking_control.disable_supported: Whether official docs allow fully disabling thinking for this model.
thinking_control.persistence: Interleaved/preserved thought handling requirements when documented.

capability_field_contract.official_capabilities: Provider-specific booleans/labels copied from model cards, such as caching, function_calling, code_execution, url_context, image_generation.
capability_field_contract.provider_catalog_references: Non-official provider catalog snapshots such as OpenRouter with model_id, context, max output, pricing, and supported parameters.
capability_field_contract.provider_pricing_raw_usd_per_unit: Full OpenRouter pricing object, raw strings, units resolved through provider_pricing_units_by_key.
capability_field_contract.provider_pricing_units_by_key: Unit label for every OpenRouter pricing key present on that model.
capability_field_contract.provider_pricing_usd_per_million_tokens: Derived only for token-priced OpenRouter keys: prompt, completion, internal_reasoning, input_cache_read, input_cache_write.
capability_field_contract.provider_supported_parameters: OpenRouter supported_parameters for OpenAI-compatible request compatibility checks.

policy.thinking_control_rule: Do not collapse thinking into only True/False when official docs expose a knob. Gemini 3/3.1/3.5 use thinkingLevel; Gemini 2.5 uses numeric thinkingBudget; GLM uses thinking.type; OpenRouter supported_parameters may show reasoning/include_reasoning but that remains provider compatibility metadata, not vendor-official thinking-budget evidence.
